title: Links are invisible to VoiceOver's Links rotor
acceptance: A link in article prose appears in VoiceOver's Links rotor
Link colour still follows the reader theme rather than reverting to system blue
Tapping a link still opens it the way it does today
notes: Found by T-0013 while doing the VoiceOver pass, and flagged as out of scope rather than quietly fixed. Prose links carry a custom `cairn.link` attribute instead of NSAttributedString.Key.link, so VoiceOver's Links rotor never sees them. The custom attribute exists for a reason — SelectableTextView's own comment says links use it so the theme owns their colour, which means resolving taps by hand. So this is not a one-line swap: using the standard key may hand colour control back to UIKit. The acceptance criteria require keeping both.
